sentences.text: Mousumi Ghosh Nee Saha vs Unknown on 17 October, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh

17.10.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.133 Criminal Revisional
Jurisdiction Ct.No.34 dc.

C.R.R. 3967 of 2023 In the matter of : Mousumi Ghosh nee Saha ... Petitioner. Mr. Arunava Ganguly
...
Liberty is granted to the petitioner to expunge the opposite party nos. 2, 3 and 4 from the present revisional application.

The petitioner is directed to serve copy of this revisional application upon the opposite party no.1 by Speed Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.
The petitioner has challenged the proceedings arising out of Complaint Case No. C-394 of 2022.
Having considered that the present complaint case is a counterblast to the case under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code initiated at the instance of the present petitioner, I direct that the revisional application would appear under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of March 2024.
Pending hearing of this revisional application, all further proceedings relating to Complaint Case No. C-394 of 2022 before the learned Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur be stayed till 31.03.2024.
All concerned parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
